net/public_suffix#

The Public Suffix List, built in: which part of a host name is a public suffix and which is the registrable domain.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let list = PublicSuffixList();
list.suffix(HostName("www.example.co.uk"));        // co.uk
list.registrable(HostName("www.example.co.uk"));   // example.co.uk
list.public(HostName("github.io"));                // true

Description#

The Public Suffix List, built in: which part of a host name is a public suffix and which is the registrable domain.

Cookies use it so a site cannot set a cookie for a whole suffix.

Public API#

object PublicSuffixList#

object PublicSuffixList

The represented list includes the pinned ICANN and PRIVATE sections. There is no runtime network update or host-installed public suffix database.
